request: Reports and jobs read their data through data connections, and a wrong setting breaks them without anyone noticing. I want a page to edit the SampleData connection's settings: its name, type, host, port, database name and the login. I want to test the connection before saving, see why a test failed in words I understand, and know what's wrong with a field before I save. Use sample data only: nothing should reach a real database. Package it.
review: The settings are grouped (connection, server, login) with required fields marked and a hint where a value isn't obvious
Saving with a required field empty or a wrong value marks each one with how to fix it, and nothing is saved
Testing the connection says whether it worked, and when it didn't, why in plain words, with the server's own message only behind details
Saving says it was saved; leaving with unsaved changes isn't silent
The password is hidden, and can be left unchanged
